recentItems.description:
Sandra (Maricel Soriano) is a wedding planner who falls in love with a much younger man, Eric (Diether Ocampo). Aside from the conflict that comes from their age difference, their relationship is further tested when Eric starts to have feelings for Sandra's employee, Lisa (Claudine Barretto). Released in 1999 and directed by Jerry Lopez Sineneng.

Starring Maricel Soriano, Claudine Barretto, and Diether Ocampo.
